Inhibitory controls: last three measured rows versus first three differ by 0.6% in Raw mean. This describes position and does not establish a plate effect.
Matched sample wells: block 2 is lower than block 1 in 75/140 pairs; median signed difference is -3.6% of the pair mean.
DMSO controls: last three measured rows versus first three differ by -10.9% in Raw mean. This describes position and does not establish a plate effect.
Inhibitory controls: last three measured rows versus first three differ by -11.9% in Raw mean. This describes position and does not establish a plate effect.
Matched sample wells: block 2 is lower than block 1 in 64/140 pairs; median signed difference is 0.9% of the pair mean.
DMSO controls: last three measured rows versus first three differ by -2.6% in Raw mean. This describes position and does not establish a plate effect.
Inhibitory controls: last three measured rows versus first three differ by 14.2% in Raw mean. This describes position and does not establish a plate effect.
At 10.0 µM, block 2 is lower in 13/14 pairs; median block 2 minus block 1 is -22.1 corrected response units. Check plate layout/readout before attributing this to compounds.

plates.control_note: GDS explicitly assigns Neutral Control to column 22 and Inhibitor Control to column 23. Their biochemical identities are not stated in the supplied files. Raw measurements come from the same-replicate instrument CSV at the same physical well; masks come from GDS.

notes: CV (%) = 100 × sample SD / positive Raw mean (SD uses n − 1). Fewer than two values or a nonpositive mean gives unavailable CV. With n = 2, sample CV is only a descriptive review measure.

Masked/ignored wells and ambiguous duplicate positions are excluded from statistics. Undefined wells remain visible but are excluded. Controls must match both source Well Type and configured columns 22 or 23.

Samples pair by physical plate, full compound ID, transfection and dose; the two wells must share a row and be exactly ten columns apart in columns 2–11 versus 12–21. Other layouts are listed as unmatched.

Control variability and block/row patterns are descriptive. No formal plate pass/fail limit is imposed. Raw channel names are preserved from the source; biochemical channel assignments require assay documentation.

model: Unweighted 4PL; free S0 and Sinf; Hill 0.1–5; search +/-2 log units beyond doses.
response_basis: 100 × (exported acceptor/donor ratio − median unmasked inhibitory-control ratio) / (median unmasked neutral-control ratio − median unmasked inhibitory-control ratio).
